//: Example Cursor MCP config for this repo. 'mcp.json' is gitignored here, so copy the server(s) you want into a real mcp.json yourself: '~/.cursor/mcp.json' (all projects) or '.cursor/mcp.json' (this project only, stays untracked). Cursor CLOUD agents do NOT read mcp.json — register the same servers in the Cursor dashboard (Integrations & MCP) instead; see scripts/setup/README.md. Run 'pnpm install' first so agent-kernel-cli's deps are present. agent-kernel-cli needs Node >= 22.18 for native .ts import; the NODE_OPTIONS below make it work even under an older 'node' on PATH.
